decisions.statement: A tier's colors are the phone's own rather than chosen ones.
Black is the rung a reading sits at before the reading has moved.
Where a reading sits among rungs is worked out the way the server works it.
A reading reaches the highest rung whose number the reading has gone over.
A scale whose numbers shrink from black through blue is read as a falling one.
A scale of fewer than two rungs is refused.
A scale neither climbing nor falling is refused.
A reading that is no finite number reaches no rung.
The fraction between two rungs is held between nothing and one.
Nothing here reads a scale page or says which rungs a scale has.
Nothing here reads the black rung in under a climbing scale.
This placing and the server's are held together by the harness alone.

definition: the color a reading has reached
